_note: Roles for the USB-adapter path via scripts/prepare_can_interfaces.py. The Duo arms and OmniHand run on the Jetson NATIVE mttcan side buses via scripts/activate_native_can.sh; use these roles only for USB CAN/CAN-FD adapters. Legacy target names such as can_nero are deprecated.

nero.description: Nero arm classic CAN USB adapter for the current single-arm or right-side baseline (legacy name can_nero is deprecated)

effector.description: Generic effector classic CAN USB adapter

omnihand.description: OmniHand CAN FD USB adapter (vendor timing; native bus is preferred). one-shot is not applied by this tool - use omnihand_canfd_activate.sh if you need it.
